description: This file defines a custom React hook named useSupabaseTable, which provides a generic interface for querying a Supabase database table with support for filters, sorting, and pagination. It manages state internally and fetches data from the database, returning data along with loading status, errors, and a refetch function.

methods.name: useSupabaseTable( table, { select = '*', filters = [], orderBy = null, page = 1, pageSize = 20, count = 'exact' } = {} )
methods.description: A React hook for fetching and managing table data from Supabase with filtering, sorting, and pagination.
